name: Indonesian Pharmaceutical & Healthcare Intelligence Extension
author: adamriofc
description: Production-grade Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BPOM Regulatory Affairs, Local Content (TKDN Farmasi), Fornas LKPP Tender, Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) Cold Chain, and Clinical Privacy compliance for Indonesian enterprises.
statutoryFrameworks: UU No. 27/2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi (UU PDP)
PP No. 32/2017 tentang Jenis dan Tarif atas Jenis Penerimaan Negara Bukan Pajak (PNBP) BPOM
PerBPOM No. 34/2018 tentang Pedoman Cara Pembuatan Obat yang Baik (CPOB)
PerBPOM No. 6/2020 tentang Perubahan atas PerBPOM No. 9/2019 tentang Pedoman Teknis Cara Distribusi Obat yang Baik (CDOB)
Permenperin No. 16/2020 tentang Ketentuan dan Tata Cara Penghitungan Nilai TKDN Produk Farmasi
Perpres No. 12/2021 tentang Pengadaan Barang/Jasa Pemerintah (E-Katalog LKPP)

skills.name: BPOM Drug Registration & NIE Navigator
skills.description: Navigate BPOM drug registration pathways (100/150/300-day SLA), ACTD dossiers, and compute statutory PNBP fees under PP No. 32/2017.

skills.name: Local Content (TKDN Farmasi) Calculator
skills.description: Calculate 4-dimension local content value for pharmaceutical finished products and APIs per Permenperin No. 16/2020.

skills.name: E-Katalog LKPP & Fornas Margin Strategist
skills.description: Model hospital/PBF distributor margins, PPN 12%, carrying cost, and price ceilings for Formularium Nasional E-Katalog sectoral tenders.

skills.name: MESO Pharmacovigilance & Adverse Drug Reaction Auditor
skills.description: Audit adverse drug reactions against WHO-UMC causality categories and calculate BPOM 15-day urgent reporting timelines under PerBPOM No. 15/2019.

skills.name: CPOB & CDOB Good Practices Auditor
skills.description: Audit compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (CPOB/cGMP) and Good Distribution Practice (CDOB/GDP) under BPOM regulations, including Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) cold-chain compliance.

skills.name: Clinical Trial Data Privacy & Health PDP Auditor
skills.description: Audit clinical trial health data handling, specific personal data classifications, and cross-border data transfer safeguards under Indonesian UU No. 27/2022.
